answer: The reef report shows the merge explicitly at each vine. Each collapsed cluster gets one orchard weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 82 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 209 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4744 identities would post 3827 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
